runtimeMapping.normal: Two source Attack events retain one input victim. One offensive SP per attack, never per damage receipt. Later hit is guarded by deploy/control/activation epochs.
runtimeMapping.skchr_irene_1: Selected rank scale, first-hit-only Levitate, original Front .367/Back .4 and second .667 events, retained victim, dead-input charge refund, cast-time ASPD and full 1.3/ASPD SP lock.
runtimeMapping.skchr_irene_2: Selected range/cap, cast-time ground victims, event .267/ASPD, mass <= selected value 3 only Levitate, two stored charges, full 1/ASPD SP lock.
runtimeMapping.skchr_irene_3: All-motion trigger, ground opener at .133, Start-to-Multi local handoff .267, selected 8/10/12 periodic random rounds, immediate physical all-motion radius1.1 explosions. Source disables attack-event waits, so six literal Spine events do not drive damage.
runtimeMapping.irene_t_1: Native pre-calculation guaranteed FLY/Levitate branches skip RNG. Ground branch rolls per physical calculation. Nonstacking derived penetration survives dodge and is cleared after output damage.
runtimeMapping.irene_t_2: Selected E2/P5 ASPD, one additional identical ASPD contribution if a live on-field source-tagged seamonster is present; never multiplied by enemy count.
runtimeMapping.castDuration: S1/S2 use original clip duration and captured ASPD. S3 uses authored PRTS fixed 3.5-second note independent of ASPD; exact native sequence lifecycle is not recovered.

verificationLimits: No recovered native C# dispatch/FSM bodies. Damage-then-Levitate order for opener hits is a local interpretation of source descriptions; first-hit talent ordering is not native-frame verified.

S3 .267 Start-to-Multi handoff, immediate first round, empty-round discard, per-round re-selection and fixed 3.5-second end are explicit local sequence mappings. Rank counts/intervals, native no-event waits and radius are recovered; six literal Spine events are not used as damage counts. Authored duration reference: https://prts.wiki/w/%E5%B0%8F%E9%B8%9F .
Original S3 Attack animation is 3.833seconds; locally ending at 3.5seconds truncates its tail. Native playback scaling/cast-finished transitions and attack cooldown resets are not recovered.

Generic status acceptance, control cancellation, shield/dodge output hooks, route ordering, hit-area radius and source-retreat cleanup are local engine mappings; original Unity runtime equivalence is not established.

Talent Sea Monster uses exact source seamonster tag on live visible units. Hidden/rebirth aura edge cases and future enemy tag ingestion are not enabled by this addition; playable enemies remain the two basic 0-1 definitions.

Modules, native Unity particles/materials/trails, camera effects, sound and physical-device touch are not supported or verified. Original default front/back Spine bytes and reviewed local animation roles are delivered separately.
